alerts.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued October 24 at 2:48AM CDT until October 25 at 7:00AM CDT by NWS Green Bay WI
alerts.description:
* WHAT...For the Dense Fog Advisory, dense fog will reduce
visibility to under one mile. For the Small Craft Advisory,
south winds 10 to 20 kt with gusts up to 25 kt and waves 2 to 5
ft expected.

* WHERE...Lake Michigan nearshore waters from Washington Island
to Sheboygan.

* WHEN...For the Dense Fog Advisory, from 9 AM to 10 AM CDT this
morning. For the Small Craft Advisory, from noon today to 7 AM
CDT Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft. Low
visibility will make navigation difficult.
